name: Multisig

subjectOf.text: Cold wallets typically lack the multisig feature that is common in hot storage, so the single employee acting as agent for a corporation may be the only access point to the corporate digital assets.
subjectOf.abstract: Accordingly, the person who acts as an agent to a corporation who holds the assets on behalf of the company may be the only access point to the corporate assets.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876
scope_conditions: corporate or treasury holdings in cold storage without multisig

subjectOf.text: Multi-signature wallets and a combination of hot and cold storage solutions are the advisable custody design for digital assets.
subjectOf.abstract: Multi-signature wallets and a combination of hot and cold storage solutions are advisable.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876

subjectOf.text: Any exercise of the multisig endowment wallet keys ultimately depends on a vote in the assembly of the DAO association that serves as legal wrapper, so a donor holding one key among many is involved in endowment payment decisions without controlling them.
subjectOf.abstract: The exercise of the multisig wallet keys will ultimately always depend on a CHARITYxDAO vote in the assembly of the CHARITYxDAO association (the legal wrapper – if chosen to be a Swiss Association). As a multisig key holder, the donor will be involved in multisig endowment payment
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021
scope_conditions: endowment wallets held in a DAO legal wrapper such as a Swiss Association

subjectOf.text: DAO governance over token launch wallets can assure that no single individual exercises rights over the token launch wallet and becomes a single point of failure or abuse.
subjectOf.abstract: DAO governance over token launch wallets can assure that no single individual exercises rights over the token launch wallet and becomes a single point of failure/abuse.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
scope_conditions: token launch wallet is governed by the DAO
